project: Directional peroxisome-dynamics score (organellomics; Hickey/Nazarov/Smertenko Plant Physiol 2023)
phase: Phase 0 - gene module definition only (no expression analysis)
design_note: Directional score = biogenesis module score - degradation(pexophagy) module score. Two cleanly separated modules per organism.

biogenesis.GO:0016560: protein import into peroxisome matrix, docking
biogenesis.GO:0016562: protein import into peroxisome matrix, receptor recycling

degradation.GO:0006914: macroautophagy (bulk - flags shared core autophagy machinery)

resolver_services.gene_resolution: mygene.info via genes-ontologies MCP (query_genes; yeast ensembl.gene=SGD ORF, arabidopsis ensembl.gene=AGI)
resolver_services.go_membership: mygene.info GO scope enumeration + QuickGO get_go_annotations (genes-ontologies MCP)
resolver_services.orthology: Ensembl Compara pan-homology via genes REST (genomes MCP ensembl_homology), Arabidopsis->S.cerevisiae direction (cross-kingdom Compara only reachable from the plant side)

positive_controls_for_downstream_validat.biogenesis_UP: oleate/oleic-acid induction -> peroxisome proliferation (S. cerevisiae). PMIDs: 22808036,20977884,20139423,19830909

collision_and_qc_flags: ATG30 / ATG37: confirmed ABSENT in S. cerevisiae (Pichia pastoris-specific pexophagy receptor/factor). S. cerevisiae uses ATG36 (YJL185C) as the pexophagy receptor. Resolved by species-restricted query (taxid 559292 not_found list).
ATG6 (yeast) resolves to VPS30/YPL120W (Beclin homolog) - alias, not a distinct gene. Recorded under systematic ID YPL120W.
Arabidopsis FIS1A symbol resolves to community name BIGYIN (AT3G57090) - same gene, kept as FIS1A for cross-organism clarity.

Arabidopsis ATG5/ATG2/ATG6 symbol searches returned alias collisions to a co-located AT3G518xx cluster (SAC8 AT3G51830, ACX4=acyl-CoA oxidase AT3G51840, metallopeptidase AT3G51800, G1 AT3G51790). All rejected; correct autophagy genes selected by MyGene name field + GO annotation (ATG5=AT5G17290, ATG2=AT3G19190, ATG6=AT3G61710).

Arabidopsis DRP5B/ARC5 (AT3G19720): Ensembl Compara pan-homology returned YOR211C, which is MGM1 (a MITOCHONDRIAL dynamin), not a peroxisomal DNM1 ortholog. Flagged spurious; DRP5B recorded as plant-specific peroxisome+chloroplast division dynamin with ortholog_confidence=none.
yeast peroxisome-organization GO term (GO:0007031) also enumerated regulators ADR1, PIP2 (and OAF-type factors) - these are transcriptional regulators and were DROPPED (see dropped_genes).
APEM9 (AT3G10572): Arabidopsis functional analog of the Pex1/Pex6 membrane anchor (ScPEX15 / mammalian PEX26); no clean Compara call, GO:0007031 assigned by TAIR curation.

Arabidopsis PEX7 (AT1G29260): Ensembl Compara pan-homology returned only non-PEX WD40 proteins (YDR030C/YEL056W), so ortholog_of was assigned to yeast PEX7 (YDR142C) by conserved family + shared GO (PTS2 receptor), ortholog_confidence=medium. YDR142C IS present in the yeast biogenesis file.

dropped_genes.reason: transcriptional activator of oleate/peroxisome genes; a REGULATOR not machinery. Appears in GO:0007031 but excluded per machinery-conserves/regulators-diverge rule; no ortholog transfer to Arabidopsis.
oleate-responsive transcription factors (Pip2-Oaf1 complex); lineage-specific regulators with no Arabidopsis ortholog transfer. Dropped from both organisms.
Pichia pastoris-specific pexophagy factors; absent in S. cerevisiae. Not applicable to this yeast module.

No Arabidopsis ortholog found (plants lack a clear ATG14/Barkor); yeast ATG14 exists but its plant partner is absent, so not transferred. Yeast ATG14 also left out of the yeast pexophagy set to avoid an unpaired-across-organism gene.
Not enumerated; module restricted to conserved machinery per cross-taxa rule.

kept as conserved/plant-specific machinery but carry ortholog_confidence=none: S. cerevisiae lacks PEX16 and ATG101; DRP5B is a plant-specific peroxisome+chloroplast-division dynamin. NOTE: ATG10 is NOT in this group - it DOES have a yeast ortholog (YLL042C, ortholog_confidence=medium).

cross_taxa_method: Machinery conserves, regulators diverge. Only conserved MACHINERY mapped yeast<->Arabidopsis. Each Arabidopsis gene carries ortholog_of (yeast systematic ID), ortholog_method (ensembl_compara_pan_homology | conserved_family_GO), ortholog_confidence (high=Compara 1:1, medium=Compara 1:many OR conserved family+GO, none=plant-specific/no yeast ortholog), and ortholog_evidence string.
notes_on_weak_arm: The pexophagy module's core_autophagy_shared genes (ATG1/8/7/3/5/12/9/2/18, PI3K complex, ATG11) OVERLAP bulk autophagy and are flagged shared_with_bulk_autophagy=True. Only ATG36 (yeast) is a peroxisome-selective receptor. This is the acknowledged weak arm of the directional score; downstream scoring should weight the selective receptor(s) and PEX-ubiquitination signal, not treat shared-autophagy genes as peroxisome-specific. NOTE: shared_with_bulk_autophagy strictly marks bulk-autophagy overlap (core_autophagy_shared + ATG11). Peroxisome fission genes (FIS1A/B, DRP3A/B, DRP5B in Arabidopsis; FIS1, DNM1, MDV1, CAF4 in yeast) are shared with MITOCHONDRIAL fission, NOT bulk autophagy, so they carry shared_with_bulk_autophagy=False in BOTH organism tables; their mitochondrial-fission sharing is documented in the notes column instead.
